_readme: First search for Mt. San Antonio College's term-by-term maps (S344, SkyWaypoint). The census found no sequence source (none_found), and the procedure record (v1, 2026-10-08) asks for the college's own map page before calling it absent. Web search (2026-10-08) found the Schedule of Classes saying a student can view the suggested order of classes to take through the Catalog, so this read takes the schedule page's links and one pilot program page (LVN-to-RN A.S. 08086) with its sections opened, looking for a map, roadmap or suggested sequence tab.

questions.map_source: Where Mt. San Antonio publishes a program's suggested term-by-term order, if anywhere.
